# Shoelace (vendored)

Subset of [@shoelace-style/shoelace](https://shoelace.style/) 2.20.1 for offline Pi kiosk use.

Includes the dark theme, button + icon + spinner components, shared chunks, and a few Bootstrap Icons used by settings.

Upgrade by re-copying from `node_modules/@shoelace-style/shoelace/cdn` after `npm pack @shoelace-style/shoelace@<version>`.
